entities.summary: Adriano Buzzati-Traverso was an Italian geneticist. He was the brother of the well-known writer Dino Buzzati. He studied X-ray induced mutations, evolutionary and population genetics. In 1962 he founded in Naples the Laboratorio Internazionale di Genetica e Biofisica which helped advance biological research in Italy and wrote several influential books on genetics.
